info.title: Bisakerja Backend API
info.description: OpenAPI reference for the Bisakerja Backend API. This document is the canonical source for the built-in Scalar API reference and covers public, authenticated, and AI-assisted routes shipped by the current runtime registry.

tags.name: Auth

tags.name: AI CV Generate

post.description: Analyzes a CV against target job roles using Model API. The CV source priority is direct PDF upload, explicit cvFileId, then the user's active CV.

jobFitAlignment.summary: The CV is reasonably aligned with the Backend Developer role because it highlights REST API, PostgreSQL, and backend project experience. Fit can improve if deployment experience is made more explicit.

atsFriendliness.summary: The CV structure is easy enough for ATS to read, but several important keywords are not summarized clearly in the skills section.

analysisResult.overallImpression: The CV shows a strong backend foundation for a junior-mid candidate, with the biggest improvement areas in measurable impact and role-specific keywords.
topActionables: Add 2-3 measurable bullets to backend experience, such as performance improvement, user count, or data scale.
Create a technical skills section that groups programming languages, databases, frameworks, and deployment tools.
Align the profile summary with the Backend Developer role so key keywords appear near the top of the CV.

sectionReviews.analysis: Relevant backend skills are present, but not all are grouped clearly.
actionPoints: Group skills into Backend, Database, Testing, and Deployment.
Prioritize skills most often requested for the target role.
sectionReviews.whyItsImportantForYou: ATS and recruiters usually look for specific skill keywords before reading experience details.

post.description: Generates improved markdown HTML CV content from a current user's stored CV reference, structured summary, and required HTML template input. Backend owns CV storage reads, structured evidence building, prompt orchestration, provider calls, template structural validation, deterministic fallback rendering, and response safety; Frontend never calls Model API directly.
